name: list_subsystems
description: The cluster's subsystems: name (sub), what their units are called, how they relate, tables.

name: get_manifest
description: A subsystem's manifest: the unit's fields (type, required, enum options and their labels, fixed, secret), field labels and the console form. Call it before writing a plan.

name: get_schema
description: The console's /schema door: schema versions of the cluster's data and processes.

name: find_units

field.description: a field of the unit, or about.<field> of the related unit

value.description: the value; a list for in/not_in

fields.description: which fields to return (all if omitted); about.<field> — the value of that field of the related unit (e.g. its counter's step)

name: field_values
description: Which values of a field occur among a subsystem's units (labels, zones, shelves, modes) and how many; about.<field> — values of a field of the related unit. Map the admin's words ("northern", "top floor") to these values.

name: list_table
description: Rows of a subsystem's table (e.g. rec's volumes). Read only.

name: propose_plan
description: Propose a plan of edits to the admin. Writes nothing: the plan is checked against the unit's form and the session's rights; the admin sees the diff and applies it. Each edit: unit "<sub>/<name>", field, from (current value), to (new value), why (which field or label put the unit in the plan).

selection.description: what the admin said. Who is selected: named — names from the request, or where — the condition from the request, in subsystem select_sub (default = edit_sub). Who is edited: edit_sub — the subsystem whose field the request changes. fields — {field: the admin's word for it} — optional: the field is checked against the request text. The check computes the selection itself and compares it with the edits. Neither named nor where — that is a question, not a plan.

field.description: a field of the unit, or about.<field> of the related unit

value.description: the value; a list for in/not_in

name: ask_admin
description: Ask the admin one short question when the request does not name the unit, the field or the value. The admin's answer comes back as the result.

name: refuse
description: Answer the admin without a plan: the request cannot be done (no such field or option, the field is fixed, no rights, an action outside the console) or there are no such units. reason — briefly why. The turn ends.
